inputs.hint: The fact is that something does not exist. Describe only how the work is done today without it, as observed events or numbers. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: {reliability_ruth} mentioned that the model performance monitoring is currently broken. She explained that the system does not track accuracy or drift in real time. Instead, her team checks the logs manually every Friday afternoon. They look for obvious errors or user complaints that indicate a problem. There is no automated alert when the model output degrades. The only way to know if the model is failing is if a customer submits a ticket. {reliability_ruth} noted that this manual review takes about two hours each week. She described the process as a simple visual scan of the recent output samples. No other tools are used to verify the model behavior between these weekly checks.
output.reclassify_reason: The text describes the current operational state and process of model monitoring without expressing any wishes, refusals, trade-offs, or explicit needs.
